topic: Decision Maker Identification - Hidden Influencer Discovery

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I can make the technical recommendation, but given our client's sensitive financial data, our security consultant and one of the board members will need to approve any new vendors.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That makes perfect sense for a family office. Security is paramount. Would it be helpful if I prepared separate presentations for the security consultant focusing on our security features and compliance certifications?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that would be ideal. The security consultant is particularly interested in data encryption and access controls. The board member wants to understand business continuity and risk mitigation.
transcript.influence_markers: Stakeholder interests clarified, presentation customization needed

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll prepare tailored materials for each stakeholder. For the security consultant, detailed encryption protocols and compliance reports. For the board member, business impact analysis and risk mitigation strategies.
